note: The Turks and Caicos Islands: nationals of the countries listed stay up to 90 days without a visa; everyone else needs a visa. Holders of a UK, US or Canadian visa or residence need none (not modelled). Read from Wikipedia's copy (the territory's immigration pages publish no list this client can read).
